perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

enhanced.name: Overflow
enhanced.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.name: Slice
enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Tracking Module
enhanced.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

enhanced.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
enhanced.description: Reloading a short time after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Clown Cartridge
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

enhanced.name: Danger Zone
enhanced.description:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Explosive Light
enhanced.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Bipod
enhanced.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

enhanced.name: Cluster Bomb
enhanced.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

enhanced.name: Quickdraw
enhanced.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Lasting Impression
enhanced.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Reverberation
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for an improved duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
